unread_scope.oracle: Every visible_books BookItem.unread equals its current real books.document.unread. Existing chapters supply an additional read/unread consistency check, never an invented no-chapter zero fallback.
unread_scope.actions: Real library tri-state, sort-direction and selection/batch-read actions; no SQL writes to books, chapters or progress.
unread_scope.mark_read: A genuinely visible unread target is selected, the actual foreground job settles, Store chapters commit read, the shown target reaches zero unread on its actual sorted page, and progress remains unchanged.
unread_scope.database: The capture's actual Demo database is data_dir/demo/library.sqlite3, opened through a read-only URI and consistent transaction.
unread_scope.scope_limit: The focused filter pair is unread include/exclude. No separate four-way downloaded filter sweep is claimed.

search_scope.pw_four: Real four-provider search and pointer-driven More select the hidden source configured with the full name MangaDex, retaining the actual keyboard draft and input mode.
search_scope.pw_twenty_five: The actual 00 and 01 configured shortcut identities are distinguishable; native More reaches the actual final Komga row and selects it without submitting the draft.
search_scope.sc_six: A real delayed provider returns series000 through series005. Actual native title/author/cover regions and six pointer hits resolve to six distinct persisted book identities.
search_scope.short_bookmark: The first actual tile is favorited by a real detail action. A separately retained real HTTP short-title response keeps that book identity and in-library bookmark in separate visible allocations.
search_scope.configuration_bound: MangaDex is the actual full name of a public loopback Komga fixture configuration in this identity test, not a claim of official MangaDex network integration. Source configuration rows alone are fixture input.
search_scope.network_bound: Four providers each receive exactly one initial search POST. The 25-source fixture records exactly 25 initial search POSTs. Genuine cover GETs are separately retained; no claim of zero total HTTP is made.
search_scope.pointer_bound: Source shortcuts, More, eligible picker rows and book tiles use actual original-PNG geometry and native press/release events. Semantic search/open or catalog/open cannot substitute for the six identity hits.

old_expectation_audit: Main881 and planb3ad have no badge_for or fixed numeric badge assertion. The old generic sort-descending case sorts title and opens a panel, so it does not replace the focused unread-direction/native-book-row evidence.
freshness: New source-bound output/run/data only. Preserve C7 full1, C8 work and every old native PNG, case JSON, manifest and visual finding without relabeling.
review_gate: Independent fresh original-PNG review must confirm badges, names, suffixes, two-line titles, author positions, bookmarks and actual visible targets. Model/Store evidence is not a rendered-text visibility claim.
result_gate: Focused exit zero qualifies only this bounded set. The retained raw main manifest remains incomplete/exit1, clean_round=false and accepted=false. After the affected original-PNG gate clears, perform two new complete full rounds on the final C9 tuple; C7 full1 supplies no C9 streak.
resource_gate: The actual source and desktop GO is subject to the final-validation owner's Native startup quiet window. Syntax preparation may continue; no App or formal timing starts until that window is released.
